shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清飘带领、收腰线与荷叶裙摆的全身廓形，抢点击率。
一秒给出三条核心利益：清新碎花、轻透雪纺、收腰显瘦，承接首屏点击。

shots.intent: 放大痛点：无腰身的厚直筒裙呆板显壮、闷而不透，反衬本款收腰与轻透雪纺。

shots.intent: 一屏同时讲清袖口抽褶牛筋收口与裙摆荷叶散开两处做工，合并同页重复卖点。

shots.intent: 以印花与织面微距替代面料声明，用视觉证明轻透雪纺与花色对位干净。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless paper-white #FFFFFF for packshots, warm paper off-white #F4F2EE for info and model screens, one flat sage panel #B7C4A3 for the benefit band and one deep tea-green #2F5D3A accent band; never gradients, never printed scenery, never real garden or street backdrops
style.iconSystem: thin 1px line glyphs in #2D2D2D only, three-card feature rows with one hairline-outlined card each; index bars where one segment is solid #2F5D3A and the rest are #F4F2EE; no 3D badges, no gold seals, no filled colour icons
style.lightingSystem: bright airy high-key daylight-feel studio light with a front-right key and a large white bounce fill on the shadow side; detail and macro screens switch to one soft raking side light to read the chiffon drape and print; shadow direction stays identical across the whole set and contact shadows are always present
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh womenswear spring chiffon-dress ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, warm paper off-white #F4F2EE, sage green panel #B7C4A3, deep tea green accent #2F5D3A and deep charcoal text #2D2D2D; cool daylight studio tone; one modern geometric sans-serif family with Chinese callouts wrapped in 「」 and thin letter-spaced latin sub-labels; matte seamless paper, pale painted-plank floor and light linen board surfaces only, no gradients, no printed scenery; bright airy high-key front-right key light with a large white bounce fill on the shadow side, single soft raking side light for detail and macro screens, one consistent shadow direction and real contact shadows; thin 1px line icons, three-card feature rows and index bars; fit-and-flare mini-dress presentation with the neck tie, smocked flounced cuffs and flounced hem never cropped and no visible face; stable product scale and placement across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no watermark, no QR code, no price digits.
noDrift: no random backgrounds or real scenery
no recoloured or drifting floral print scale in detail and variant panels
no visible model faces or recognisable likeness
no hands holding or pinching the garment
no watermarks, store badges, membership badges, QR codes or price digits
style.presentationRules: the dress always reads as a fit-and-flare mini with the self-fabric neck tie, the smocked flounced cuff and the flounced above-knee hem fully inside frame; every on-model crop sits above the jawline so no face appears; print scale, ground colour and blossom colour never drift between shots; chiffon must keep its airy drape and soft transparency, never smoothed or made opaque; garment scale identical across the split screens, the hanger pair and the colourway row
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper backdrop for standing and hanging shots, pale painted-plank floor #EFEAE2 for the lifestyle screen, light linen board #F4F2EE for flat-lays; no gloss, no mirror reflection, no visible weave in the backdrop
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; Chinese callouts wrapped in 「」, thin letter-spaced latin sub-labels under section headlines; headline 28-40pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 10-14pt; hairline rules, one numbered section marker style; never mix serif, handwritten or retro lettering
